notes: v668 - fixes a confusing label on the My Picks form. The 'Sell at $' and 'Stop $' boxes showed the grey hint '% rule', which reads as an instruction to type a percentage. It actually meant 'leave this blank and your percentage rule from My Rules will be used'. Both boxes want a dollar PRICE, so a percentage was never going to be accepted. They now read 'blank = use my %', and hovering either one explains that it wants a price and what happens if you leave it empty. Nothing changed about how the fields work - only what they told you. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
